spectrum_swirl_supernova.notes: The little "star glints" look hand drawn by a 5 year old. I never love when they show up on your outputs unless they'd look much, much better. I'm cool with the Swirl Supernova concept otherwise. Also the spec map it a little lacking in variety and diversity

spectrum_data_etch.notes: Look how large these areas are. They are MASSIVE on a 2048x2048 canvas. Idea is fine but we can't have slices like this so large.

spectrum_grating_quilt.notes: We have a lot of finishes like this already but this is also VERY blobby. Just way too big. We have tons of voroni fracture type looks. We need NEW and UNIQUE looks not in the database at all

spectrum_thermo_touch.notes: Spec way too blotchy needs much finer details

spectrum_smectic_fan.notes: Another that's too blotchy and the spec is too big also and these look a lot like many others. Need fresh ideas/looks. These voronoi looks are all over the app now as it is

spectrum_prism_pool.notes: The spec map needs to be much more detailed/alive

spectrum_clockwork_dial.notes: Very unique idea but the patterns on the paint and spec are way way too big. Need 40x finer detail.

spectrum_event_horizon.notes: Seeing a lot of these look the same. REDSHIFT DRIFT, MAGNET FLOW, ORBITAL ENGRAVE - they are all way too similar

spectrum_shatter_glass.notes: No more voronoi/shattered glass/stained glass looks for now. Make something TRULY UNIQUE

spectrum_peacock_eye.notes: Need about 75x more peacock eyes and they need to be about 1/3 of the current size

spectrum_vhs_phantom.notes: LOVE the idea behind it but the result is not where it should be at all. Too blotchy, too similar to others and most importantly it doesn't LOOK like VHS scanlines. You should research what VHS scanlines actually look like.

spectrum_flare_spectra.notes: Probably the laziest and weakest output here. Pattern design on paint is very sparse and awful

spectrum_singularity_lens.notes: It looks like those weird 5 year old hand drawn stars again.

spectrum_magnet_flow.notes: Just don't like this overall look/style
